objectives.joint: minimum worst-branch TOTAL requests Q, including probe/setup/stop/cleanup; native G reported separately
objectives.warning: B optimum is conditional single-world advisory, never a uniform policy or an exclusion rule; joint Q does not promise minimal G

AB3: independent full Post + witness/refutation replay; independently recomputed favourable-outcome relaxation for bound; fail closed
A4: common safe-action eligibility, resource context, union policy replay and matching member lower bound; reject/refine or exact fallback
B4: zero-cost identical-delegate semantic path-class compression; globally lexical expansion; no equal-G-only dominance
comparison: same model/actions/approvals/budgets; all eight combinations use a complete conditional B solver and control-policy solver; all costs metered
implemented_subset: original source parser allows <=4 probes and <=6 joint paths; no claim of covering all W0 inputs
development_split: all new inputs are development diagnostics; no holdout used
partial_order: AB3 minimum checked gate must precede A4/B4 measurements
